projects.title: Voice-First Time Logger (Speech → DeepSeek API → Master Portal)
projects.description: Core Spark AI lesson: speak to LLMs instead of typing. Jack builds a mobile-friendly voice input dashboard where he dictates his work summary from Studio 1385 or Home; the DeepSeek API parses his speech into structured JSON and plugs it into this Master Dashboard.

milestones.title: 1. Mobile & Desktop Voice Capture UI ("Speak, Don't Type")
milestones.detail: Microphone speech capture on Jack's personal logger dashboard so he can speak updates from his phone or workstation

milestones.title: 2. DeepSeek API Structured JSON Parser
milestones.detail: Wire deepseek-chat (JSON mode) to parse natural speech into strict date, location (Studio 1385 vs. Remote / Home), hours, project, and summary

milestones.title: 3. Wire DeepSeek Output to Master Portal
milestones.detail: Push parsed voice logs directly into data/jack-feed.json (or live endpoint) to populate this Master Dashboard

milestones.title: 4. Live Voice Check-Ins (Studio 1385 & Remote / Home)
milestones.detail: Speak and verify real Studio 1385 and work-from-home sessions end-to-end

projects.title: Studio Onboarding & AI Tooling Foundations
projects.description: Hands-on orientation at Studio 1385 covering Mac workstation setup, local language models, structured prompt engineering, and Spark AI client workflows.

milestones.title: 1. Mac Studio Setup & Environment
milestones.detail: Studio 1385 workstation orientation, tools, and privacy/security guidelines

milestones.title: 2. LLM APIs, Local Models & Prompt Engineering
milestones.detail: Structured JSON schemas, system prompts, local Apple Silicon models, and output verification
